heraliz_quetes.tuto.varga: Out here, without a shelter for your gear, you won't last a week. Start a clan to build a base. Meanwhile, I can give you your first mission.
heraliz_quetes.guide.intro: Go see the Guide: he'll show you around spawn
heraliz_quetes.guide.suivi_visite: Tour of spawn with the Guide
heraliz_quetes.guide.accueil: Welcome to the camp, survivor. Just arrived? Let me show you around: I'll introduce you to everyone who matters here.
heraliz_quetes.guide.accueil_connu: You again! Want me to show you around the camp once more?
heraliz_quetes.guide.mila: This is Mila. She buys everything valuable you find on the map for herals: rare items, components, salvage.
heraliz_quetes.guide.batisseur: That's the Builder: planks, stone, metal, building plan and hammer. Everything you need for your base.
heraliz_quetes.guide.jacqueline: Jacqueline, our medic. Bandages, splints, kits: see her before heading out on the map.
heraliz_quetes.guide.doyen: The Elder runs the supplies: food to keep you going out there.
heraliz_quetes.guide.jack: Jack, the gunsmith: scopes, grips, suppressors… everything to improve your weapons.
heraliz_quetes.guide.varga: And this is Commander Varga. He gives out the missions, and he'll help you build your base.
heraliz_quetes.guide.fin: That's the tour. Go talk to Commander Varga: he's waiting for you. Follow the green trail.
heraliz_quetes.guide.casino: This is the casino. You'll collect caps while exploring the world: caps are one of HeraliZ's currencies, and the casino trades them for rewards.
heraliz_quetes.guide.armurier: This is the Gunsmith Table: weapons, ammo, medical supplies, scopes, explosives, components… This is where you craft your gear, the heart of your arsenal.
heraliz_quetes.guide.coffre: This safe is your stash (Safe Planque 1): what you store in it is yours alone, other players can't steal anything from it. The VIP chest is only for players with a shop rank.
heraliz_quetes.guide.caisses: Here are the crates: Camo, Vote, Emotes, Gem, Quest… You need a key to open one. You get crates and keys by progressing and exploring.
heraliz_quetes.guide.borne: This terminal is your way out: right-click, stay still for a few seconds, and you're sent to a random point on the map. That's where exploring begins.
heraliz_quetes.guide.recycleur: And the recycler: give it the weapons and items you don't need anymore, it gives you components back, and a few herals when nothing comes out.

heraliz_quetes.tuto.intro: Go see Commander Varga for your first missions
heraliz_quetes.tuto.kit: Listen to Varga: off to the tutorial world
heraliz_quetes.tuto.retour: Go back to the tutorial world to finish your cabin
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.1: Take the building plan in hand
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.4: Place the 5 walls and the door
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.7: Place the Claim Block in the cabin
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.8: Put planks in the Claim Block
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.10: Set your home: /home poser in the cabin
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.1: Varga here. Let's build you a shelter. Take the building plan: the slot blinking green in your hotbar. And relax: nobody can hurt you until your base is finished.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.2: Good. Aim at a flat spot: the foundation shows up in front of you. Left click to place it. If you have another piece, hold right click: the Foundation blinks in the wheel.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.3: Perfect. The second foundation blinks green, right next to the first one. Aim at it and left click: it's the only spot allowed.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.4: Put the walls up: aim at each blinking green piece and left click. To change piece, hold right click and pick the one blinking in the wheel: Wall, or Doorway for the entrance.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.5: You need a roof. In the wheel (hold right click), pick Floor, then place the 2 green floors on top of the walls.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.6: Right now it's just twigs: it won't hold anything. Take the hammer (it blinks), aim at a piece blinking orange, hold right click and pick Wood. Do it on every orange piece.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.7: Solid. Now the Claim Block, your tool cabinet: take it from your hotbar and aim at the green frame, in the back corner of the cabin. It sets itself against the walls. This ground becomes yours.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.8: A base decays if nobody maintains it. Right click the Claim Block and put planks from the Builder in it: the counter on the right tells you how many.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.9: Now take the metal crate and aim at the green frame, against the wall right next to the Claim Block. Store your gear in it, and always close the door behind you: an open door is an invitation.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.1: Look at your hotbar at the bottom of the screen: the green slot is the plan. Press its number or scroll the mouse wheel to it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.2: With the plan in hand, look at the ground in front of you, not too far: the foundation shows up. Green means you can place it: left click. Red: move to a flatter spot.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.3: Walk up to your first foundation and look at the green piece blinking next to it. When the piece you aim at sits on it, left click.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.4: Walk up to the edge of a foundation and look at the blinking green piece. If the wheel shows another piece than the blinking one, hold right click and pick the blinking one.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.5: Look at the top of a wall: the green floor shows up above it. If it doesn't, hold right click and pick Floor in the wheel.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.6: Walk up to an orange wall, hammer in hand, and look right at it. Hold right click: a wheel opens. Move to Wood, which blinks, and let go.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.7: The Claim Block is in your hotbar (it blinks). Take it, go inside the cabin and aim at the bottom of the green frame, in the back corner: right click to place it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.8: Aim at the Claim Block and right click: a small screen opens. Drag planks from your inventory into the planks slot at the top.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.9: The metal crate is in your hotbar (it blinks). Take it and aim at the bottom of the green frame, against the wall next to the Claim Block: right click to place it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.10: One last thing: your home. Stand inside your cabin, on the floor, and type /home poser in the chat. From spawn, /home will bring you back here.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.10: Press T to open the chat, type /home poser then Enter. You must be inside your cabin, standing on the foundation or floor, not outside on the grass.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin: Nice work. Look at it, your base. I added an airlock in front of the entrance: two doors to break instead of one, and while both are open, nobody gets through. For %s days, nobody can raid it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin2: After that, anyone can attack it. During an attack, your base goes into raid block: no more building or repairing. Always keep planks in the Claim Block.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin_sans_sas: Nice work. That was a practice cabin: it will disappear. Your clan's real base goes on the map, away from towns and loot; for %s days, nobody will be able to raid it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin_np: Nice work. Look at it, your base. I added an airlock in front of the entrance: two doors to break instead of one, and while both are open, nobody gets through.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin_sans_sas_n: Nice work. That was a practice cabin: it will disappear. Your clan's real base goes on the map, away from towns and loot.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin2_np: Anyone can attack it as soon as it is built. During an attack, your base goes into raid block: no more building or repairing. Always keep planks in the Claim Block.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin3: I'm taking you back to spawn. Once your clan's base is placed, use /home poser inside it, and from spawn /home will bring you there. Come see me at spawn for missions.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.spawn: Go back to spawn (/spawn): Varga wants to introduce you to someone
heraliz_quetes.tuto.rappel_spawn: Type /spawn: I'm waiting for you at spawn, there's someone else I want you to meet.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.batisseur.1: That's the Builder: he sells everything for your base. Quickly upgrade your walls and doors to stone, then metal: in wood, your base won't survive a raid.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.batisseur.1_sans: At spawn, go see the Builder: he sells everything for your base. Quickly upgrade your walls and doors to stone, then metal: in wood, your base won't survive a raid.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.batisseur.2: Each upgrade also costs an item from the map: nails, cement, brackets or welding wire. All prices are in /base info: I'm opening it for you.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.notif_fin: Tutorial complete: Commander Varga is waiting for you at spawn with missions
